seo.title: About Doggzy - Our Mission to Save Dogs Worldwide
seo.description: We're a global network of passionate dog lovers, rescue organizations, and volunteers working together to save lives and create happy endings for dogs in need.

hero.title: Our Mission:
hero.subtitle: We're a global network of passionate dog lovers, rescue organizations, and volunteers working together to save lives, provide medical care, and create happy endings for dogs in need.

story.title: Our Story
paragraphs: Doggzy was born from a simple belief: every dog deserves a chance at a happy life. What started as a small rescue operation in San Francisco has grown into a global movement that has saved over 15,000 lives.

Our founder, Sarah Johnson, was working as a veterinary technician when she realized that many rescue organizations were working in isolation. She envisioned a platform that could connect shelters, volunteers, and donors worldwide to maximize impact.

Today, we work with 342 partner shelters across 47 countries, creating a network of compassion that spans the globe. Every donation, every adoption, and every act of kindness contributes to our mission of ensuring no dog is left behind.
